title: Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’ K33 Research said bitcoin is in "deep value territory" after a 14% weekly drop, as ETF outflows, liquidations and hedging demand reach levels seen near past bottoms. This post Analyst: Bitcoin Below $70,000 is a ‘Gift From the Market’ first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
